steps.name: Prepare environment: workspace and runtime/version validation
steps.description: Create the workspace directory, ensure ownership, verify Node/npm/npx/yarn presence and minimum versions, and log versions. Do not write to /etc/profile.d unless PERSIST_GLOBAL_ENV=1 is set (writing is supported but opt-in to avoid unexpected global changes). If a project with package.json exists, log react-scripts version. Operates in /home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/an-infinite-canvas-unpainted-12-89/ObjectStorage.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/an-infinite-canvas-unpainted-12-89/ObjectStorage"
sudo mkdir -p "$WS" && sudo chown -R "$(id -u):$(id -g)" "$WS"
# Safe version extraction with fallbacks
node_v=$(node -v 2>/dev/null || true)
node_major=$(echo "$node_v" | sed -E 's/^v?([0-9]+).*$/\1/' || true)
if [ -z "${node_major:-}" ] || [ "$node_major" -lt 16 ]; then
  echo "ERROR: node >=16 required; found: ${node_v:-missing}" >&2; exit 2
fi
# npm
npm_v=$(npm -v 2>/dev/null || echo "missing")
npx_v=$(npx --version 2>/dev/null || echo "missing")
yarn_v=$(yarn -v 2>/dev/null || echo "absent")
# If package exists, log react-scripts
if [ -f "$WS/package.json" ]; then
  rs=$(node -e 'try{const p=require("./package.json"); console.log((p.dependencies&&p.dependencies["react-scripts"])||(p.devDependencies&&p.devDependencies["react-scripts"])||"none");}catch(e){console.log("invalid");}' 2>/dev/null || echo "invalid")
else
  rs="none"
fi
echo "node=${node_v} npm=${npm_v} npx=${npx_v} yarn=${yarn_v} react-scripts=${rs}"
# Ensure at least npm or yarn available
command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1 || command -v yarn >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ERROR: npm or yarn required on PATH" >&2; exit 3; }
# Optional minimal global persistence: opt-in only
if [ "${PERSIST_GLOBAL_ENV:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  PROFILE=/etc/profile.d/node_env.sh
  TMP=/tmp/node_env.sh.$$
  cat >"$TMP" <<'EOF'
# Persist minimal NODE_ENV for interactive shells
export NODE_ENV=development
EOF
  if ! sudo test -f "$PROFILE" || ! sudo cmp -s "$TMP" "$PROFILE"; then sudo cp "$TMP" "$PROFILE" && sudo chmod 644 "$PROFILE"; fi
  rm -f "$TMP"
fi

steps.name: Scaffold CRA project safely (idempotent, preserve existing files)
steps.description: Create or validate a Create React App project in the workspace. If package.json exists and appears CRA-like, ensure node_modules/react-scripts is present; otherwise install deps. If workspace is empty, run create-react-app in-place. If non-empty and no CRA present, scaffold into a temp dir and merge using rsync --ignore-existing to preserve user files and dotfiles. Respect TYPESCRIPT=1 to use the TypeScript template. Create a headless .env and local-storage directory. Operates in /home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/an-infinite-canvas-unpainted-12-89/ObjectStorage.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/an-infinite-canvas-unpainted-12-89/ObjectStorage"
cd "$WS"
# Ensure npx exists
command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ERROR: npx required" >&2; exit 2; }
# If package.json exists, validate CRA-like
if [ -f package.json ]; then
  node -e 'try{const p=require("./package.json"); const ok=(p.dependencies&&p.dependencies["react-scripts"])||(p.devDependencies&&p.devDependencies["react-scripts"])|| (p.scripts && (p.scripts.start||p.scripts.build)); if(!ok){console.error("package.json present but not CRA-like"); process.exit(2);} }catch(e){console.error("invalid package.json"); process.exit(3);}'; then
    if [ -d node_modules/react-scripts ]; then echo "Existing CRA project detected"; exit 0; fi
    echo "package.json indicates CRA but node_modules/react-scripts missing; installing dependencies via npm ci..." >&2
    # If package-lock exists prefer CI
    if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci --prefer-offline --no-audit --no-fund || { echo "npm ci failed" >&2; exit 4; }; else npm install --no-audit --no-fund || { echo "npm install failed" >&2; exit 5; }; fi
    exit 0
fi
# Determine if directory is empty (ignore . and ..)
non_empty=$(find . -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 | wc -l || true)
TS_OPT=""; [ "${TYPESCRIPT:-0}" = "1" ] && TS_OPT="--template typescript"
if [ "$non_empty" -eq 0 ]; then
  # empty workspace: scaffold in-place with small retry
  n=0; until n=$((n+1)) && npx create-react-app . --use-npm $TS_OPT >/dev/null 2>&1 && break || [ $n -lt 3 ]; do sleep 1; done
  if [ $n -ge 3 ]; then echo "create-react-app failed after retries" >&2; exit 6; fi
else
  # non-empty: scaffold into temp and merge safely (preserve existing files)
  TMPDIR=$(mktemp -d)
  trap 'rm -rf "$TMPDIR"' EXIT
  n=0; until n=$((n+1)) && npx create-react-app "$TMPDIR" --use-npm $TS_OPT >/dev/null 2>&1 && break || [ $n -lt 3 ]; do sleep 1; done
  if [ $n -ge 3 ]; then echo "create-react-app failed after retries" >&2; exit 7; fi
  # Use rsync to copy including dotfiles and avoid overwriting existing files
  command -v rsync >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ERROR: rsync required" >&2; exit 8; }
  rsync -a --chmod=Du=rwx,Dg=rx,Do=rx,Fu=rw,Fg=r,Fo=r --ignore-existing "$TMPDIR/" "$WS/" || true
  rm -rf "$TMPDIR"
fi
# Create project .env for headless development (preserve if exists)
if [ ! -f "$WS/.env" ]; then
  cat > "$WS/.env" <<'EOF'
# Headless development env vars - no secrets
HOST=127.0.0.1
PORT=3000
REACT_APP_HEADLESS=true
EOF
fi
mkdir -p "$WS/local-storage" && chmod 755 "$WS/local-storage"

steps.name: Install minimal dependencies and configure lint/test (idempotent, single install path)
steps.description: Install only essential runtime dependencies (react, react-dom) and testing/lint tooling in an idempotent manner. Decide install strategy: if package-lock.json exists and node_modules missing, run npm ci once; else compute missing runtime/dev dependencies and install them in a single npm install command. Prefer react-scripts' built-in test/lint. For non-CRA projects, install jest and minimal ESLint parser/plugins. Ensure package.json scripts are preserved except for adding a reasonable test script if missing. Operates in workspace.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/an-infinite-canvas-unpainted-12-89/ObjectStorage"
cd "$WS"
# helper to check package.json safely
has_pkg_field() { node -e "try{const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(!!(p$1));}catch(e){console.log('false');}" 2>/dev/null || echo false; }
# If node_modules missing and package-lock exists, use npm ci (single action)
if [ ! -d node_modules ] && [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
  npm ci --prefer-offline --no-audit --no-fund || { echo "npm ci failed" >&2; exit 6; }
else
  # Determine missing runtime deps: react, react-dom
  missing=( )
  if ! node -e "try{const p=require('./package.json'); if(!(p.dependencies&&p.dependencies.react)) process.exit(1);}catch(e){process.exit(1)}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then missing+=(react); fi
  if ! node -e "try{const p=require('./package.json'); if(!(p.dependencies&&p.dependencies['react-dom'])) process.exit(1);}catch(e){process.exit(1)}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then missing+=(react-dom); fi
  if [ ${#missing[@]} -ne 0 ]; then npm install --no-audit --no-fund "${missing[@]}" || { echo "install runtime deps failed" >&2; exit 7; }; fi
fi
# Detect if project uses react-scripts
uses_cra=false
if node -e 'try{const p=require("./package.json"); if((p.dependencies&&p.dependencies["react-scripts"])||(p.devDependencies&&p.devDependencies["react-scripts"])) process.exit(0); process.exit(1);}catch(e){process.exit(1)}' >/dev/null 2>&1; then uses_cra=true; fi
# Testing libs and ESLint handling
if [ "$uses_cra" = true ]; then
  # Prefer CRA built-in ESLint and test; add testing-library only
  npm install -D --no-audit --no-fund @testing-library/react @testing-library/jest-dom || { echo "install testing libs failed" >&2; exit 8; }
  # Ensure test script exists and keep other scripts
  node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const p=fs.existsSync("package.json")?require("./package.json"):{};p.scripts=p.scripts||{}; if(!p.scripts.test) p.scripts.test="react-scripts test --env=jsdom --runInBand"; fs.writeFileSync("package.json",JSON.stringify(p,null,2))'
else
  # Non-CRA: install jest and testing libs
  npm install -D --no-audit --no-fund jest @testing-library/react @testing-library/jest-dom || { echo "install jest/testing libs failed" >&2; exit 9; }
  # add minimal ESLint react parser/plugins to avoid JSX parse errors
  npm install -D --no-audit --no-fund eslint-plugin-react @babel/eslint-parser || { echo "install eslint plugins failed" >&2; exit 10; }
  node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const p=fs.existsSync("package.json")?require("./package.json"):{};p.scripts=p.scripts||{}; if(!p.scripts.test) p.scripts.test="jest --runInBand"; fs.writeFileSync("package.json",JSON.stringify(p,null,2))'
fi
# TypeScript typings when requested
if [ "${TYPESCRIPT:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  npm install -D --no-audit --no-fund @types/react @types/react-dom || { echo "install TS types failed" >&2; exit 11; }
  [ -f tsconfig.json ] || npx tsc --init >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
fi
# ESLint config: prefer extending CRA if available, else minimal react-capable config
if [ "$uses_cra" = true ]; then
  # create minimal file that extends react-scripts if not present
  if [ ! -f .eslintrc.json ]; then
    cat > .eslintrc.json <<'EOF'
{ "extends": ["react-app", "react-app/jest"] }
EOF
  fi
else
  cat > .eslintrc.json <<'EOF'
{ "env": { "browser": true, "es2021": true }, "extends": ["eslint:recommended"], "parser": "@babel/eslint-parser", "parserOptions": {"requireConfigFile": false, "ecmaVersion": 2021, "sourceType": "module", "ecmaFeatures": {"jsx": true}}, "plugins": ["react"], "rules": {} }
EOF
fi
cat > .eslintignore <<'EOF'
node_modules
build
public
EOF
# Add smoke test (preserve if exists)
EXT=js
if [ -f src/App.tsx ] || [ -f src/index.tsx ]; then EXT=tsx; fi
mkdir -p src/__tests__
if [ ! -f "src/__tests__/smoke.test.${EXT}" ]; then
  cat > "src/__tests__/smoke.test.${EXT}" <<'EOF'
import React from 'react';
import { render } from '@testing-library/react';
import App from '../App';
test('renders without crashing', () => { render(<App />); });
EOF
fi

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/an-infinite-canvas-unpainted-12-89/ObjectStorage"
cd "$WS"
# Prefer project/react-scripts lint if available
if node -e 'try{const p=require("./package.json"); if((p.dependencies&&p.dependencies["react-scripts"])||(p.devDependencies&&p.devDependencies["react-scripts"])) process.exit(0); process.exit(1);}catch(e){process.exit(1)}' >/dev/null 2>&1; then

  if command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    npx react-scripts lint src --quiet || { echo "react-scripts lint failed" >&2; exit 12; }
  fi
else
  # fallback to npx eslint scoped to src
  if command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1; then

  else
    echo "ERROR: npx not found for lint" >&2; exit 14
  fi
fi
# Run tests: adapt to runner
# Use timeout (GNU coreutils timeout) to avoid long hangs; 300s limit
if node -e 'try{const p=require("./package.json"); if((p.dependencies&&p.dependencies["react-scripts"])||(p.devDependencies&&p.devDependencies["react-scripts"])) process.exit(0); process.exit(1);}catch(e){process.exit(1)}' >/dev/null 2>&1; then

else

  timeout 300 npx jest --runInBand --ci || { echo "Jest tests failed" >&2; exit 16; }
fi

steps.name: Serve build, verify HTTP and content, and cleanup (robust .env parsing)
steps.description: Serve the build directory via python3 -m http.server bound to HOST/PORT determined from .env or defaults. .env parsing trims whitespace and strips quotes, supports REACT_APP_ prefixed flags for headless indicators, validates PORT numericity, waits for readiness with backoff, verifies index.html contains '<div id="root">', and ensures the server process is terminated and waited-for. Operates in workspace.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/an-infinite-canvas-unpainted-12-89/ObjectStorage"
cd "$WS"
# Robust .env parse: accept simple KEY=VALUE, trim and strip quotes
HOST_DEFAULT=127.0.0.1
PORT_DEFAULT=3000
HOST=""
PORT=""
if [ -f .env ]; then
  while IFS='=' read -r k v; do
    k=$(echo "$k" | tr -d '\r' | sed -E 's/^[[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+$//g')
    v=$(echo "${v:-}" | sed -E 's/^[[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+$//g' | sed -E 's/^"(.*)"$/\1/; s/^\'(.*)\'$/\1/')
    case "$k" in
      ''|\#*) continue;;
      HOST|REACT_APP_HOST) HOST="$v";;
      PORT|REACT_APP_PORT) PORT="$v";;
      REACT_APP_HEADLESS) REACT_APP_HEADLESS="$v";;
    esac
  done < <(grep -E '^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*=' .env || true)
fi
HOST=${HOST:-$HOST_DEFAULT}
PORT=${PORT:-$PORT_DEFAULT}
# Validate numeric port
if ! printf '%s' "$PORT" | grep -qE '^[0-9]+$'; then echo "ERROR: PORT not numeric: $PORT" >&2; exit 19; fi
cd build
# Start server bound to HOST if python supports --bind
if python3 -m http.server --help 2>&1 | grep -q -- '--bind'; then
  python3 -m http.server "$PORT" --bind "$HOST" >/dev/null 2>&1 &
else
  python3 -m http.server "$PORT" >/dev/null 2>&1 &
fi
SERVER_PID=$!
# ensure cleanup and wait for termination
cleanup(){ kill "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; }
trap cleanup EXIT
# Wait for server readiness with backoff
attempts=0; max=20; sleep_s=0.5
while [ $attempts -lt $max ]; do
  if curl -sSf "http://${HOST}:${PORT}/" >/dev/null 2>&1; then break; fi
  attempts=$((attempts+1))
  sleep $sleep_s
  sleep_s=1
done
if ! curl -sSf "http://${HOST}:${PORT}/" -o /tmp/obj_storage_index.html 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "ERROR: server did not respond on ${HOST}:${PORT}" >&2; exit 20
fi
# Verify expected content marker in index.html
if ! grep -q "<div id=\"root\">" /tmp/obj_storage_index.html; then
  echo "ERROR: index.html content missing expected '<div id=\"root\">' marker" >&2; exit 21
fi
echo "validation: success - served at http://${HOST}:${PORT}/"
# cleanup via trap
